units.source_text: 这僧都闭居深山，朝廷召唤也不接受，

en.t: This bishop lived shut away deep in the mountains and would not even answer summons from the court,

units.source_text: 现在轻易下山来替这样的一个人大办祈祷，

en.t: but now he had readily come down from the mountain to conduct elaborate prayers for such a person,

units.source_text: 倘被世人纷纷议论起来，实在很不好听。

en.t: and if people began gossiping about it, it would sound truly unseemly.

units.source_text: 他自己这样想，他的徒弟们也这样说。

en.t: He thought so himself, and his disciples said the same.

units.source_text: 因此秘密举办，不使外人闻知。

en.t: For that reason they held the rites in secret and let no outsiders hear of them.

units.source_text: 他对众徒弟说：“各位请不要声张！

en.t: He said to all his disciples, "Please, everyone, do not spread word of this.

units.source_text: 我是一个不知羞惭的僧人，多次违反了佛戒。

en.t: I am a shameless monk and have violated the Buddhist precepts many times.

units.source_text: 然而关于女人之事，从来不曾犯什么过错，亦从来不曾受人讥评。

en.t: Yet in matters concerning women I have never committed any fault, nor have I ever been criticized by others.

units.source_text: 如今年届六十余龄，若再受人非难，也是前世命定的了。”

en.t: Now that I am past sixty, if I am criticized again, it must be something fated from a former life."

units.source_text: 徒弟们说：“若有不良之人乱造谣言，这便成了佛法上的瑕疵。”

en.t: The disciples said, "If malicious people invent wild rumors, this will become a blemish on the Buddhist Law."

units.source_text: 他们都不以为然。

en.t: None of them approved.

units.source_text: 但僧都不管，立下种种严肃的誓言，说：“此次祈祷若不见效，死不罢休！”

en.t: But the bishop paid no heed, made many solemn vows, and said, "If these prayers have no effect, I will not stop even if it kills me!"

units.source_text: 便通夜祈祷，直到天明，定要把这鬼魂移到巫婆身上，

en.t: Then he prayed through the night until dawn, determined to transfer the spirit into the medium's body,

units.source_text: 然后叫它说出来：是何种妖魔？

en.t: and then make it speak and say what kind of demon it was.

units.source_text: 为何如此使人受苦？

en.t: Why did it make people suffer like this?

units.source_text: 又叫他的弟子阿阇梨来合力祈祷。

en.t: He also called his disciple, the ajari, to join forces in prayer.

units.source_text: 于是几个月来绝不显露的鬼魂，终于被制服了。

en.t: Thus the spirit that had not revealed itself for several months was finally subdued.

units.source_text: 这鬼魂借巫婆之口大声叫道：“我本来是不会到这里来被你们如此制服的。

en.t: The spirit cried out loudly through the medium's mouth, "I never meant to come here and be subdued by you like this.

units.source_text: 我昔在世之时，是个修行有素的法师。

en.t: Long ago, when I lived in this world, I was a well-trained priest.

units.source_text: 只因死时在人世留有遗恨，便彷徨于鬼途，不得超生。

en.t: Only because I left resentment behind in the human world when I died, I wandered on the path of spirits and could not attain release.

units.source_text: 这期间我住在许多美女所居的宇治山庄中，

en.t: During that time I lived in the Uji villa where many beautiful women resided,

units.source_text: 前年已曾制死了其中一人。

en.t: and the year before last I had already brought one of them to her death.

units.source_text: 现在这个人自己真心厌世，日日夜夜地说‘我要寻死’，

en.t: Now this woman herself truly hated the world and said day and night, 'I want to die,'

units.source_text: 我就得其所哉。

en.t: so I found exactly the opportunity I wanted.

units.source_text: 有一天深黑之夜，她独自彷徨，我就取了她去。

en.t: One pitch-dark night, when she was wandering alone, I took her away.

units.source_text: 然而观世音菩萨多方保护她，我终于被这僧都制服了。

en.t: But Bodhisattva Kannon protected her in many ways, and in the end I was subdued by this bishop.

units.source_text: 现在我就走吧！”

en.t: Now I shall go!"

units.source_text: 僧都便问：“那么你叫什么名字？”

en.t: The bishop then asked, "Then what is your name?"

units.source_text: 大约是这巫婆怯弱之故，并不清楚地说出名字来。

en.t: Probably because the medium was timid, the name was not spoken clearly.
